description: Load swatches into the active document (Swatches panel menu > Load Swatches) from an InDesign document or template or an Adobe Swatch Exchange (.ase) file, and/or import named colours from Adobe colour books such as PANTONE as spot or process colours

file.description: Path of an .indd, .indt or .ase file to load swatches from

processColors.description: Colour-book colour names to import as process colours

spotColors.description: Colour-book colour names to import as spot colours, e.g. "PANTONE 185 C"

name: load_swatches
title: Load Swatches
